decoder_provenance: Each child receipt binds its separately retained transcribe.py SHA, model revision, installed versions and decoding signature.
first_pass_policy: Failed acquisition records remain final within that in-memory process. Existing ASR receipts are strictly verified and reused.
resumed_pass_policy: Updated run_queue.py reopens later completed acquisitions and awaits explicitly approved pending source promotions; all existing ASR receipts are reverified.
